title: [SESSION_127] ZoneAnalyzer: Improve Bounding Box Overlap Detection (Phase 23)
body:
## Feature: Full Bounding Box Overlap Detection

**Component:** ZoneAnalyzer (`/nodes/behavior_nodes/zone_analyzer/`)
**Severity:** 🟠 HIGH
**Session:** SESSION 127 (Definition of Done)
**Current Status:** Uses bbox center only for containment
**Target Phase:** Phase 23

## Context

Zone detection accuracy is compromised by center-point-only testing. When a person's bounding box center crosses a zone boundary, the person may be 30-50% outside the zone but is marked as "inside".

## Requirements

- Check if entire bounding box overlaps zone polygon
- Not just center point containment
- Handle partial overlaps and edge cases
- Maintain performance (<100ms per frame)

## Impact

**Without this feature:**
- False positives for zone entries
- Accuracy reduced (especially at boundaries)
- Inaccurate dwell time tracking
- Violation reporting unreliable

## Effort Estimate

- Bbox-polygon intersection: 1.5-2 hours
- Testing with edge cases: 1-1.5 hours
- **Total: 2-3 hours**

## Technical Approach

- Shapely bbox-polygon intersection
- Overlap threshold (e.g., >50% for "inside")
- Edge case handling (partial occlusion)

---
